description: Longer schedule (60 epochs) for a run of configs/train_s4_ft100d.json that the sufficiency rule flagged (best checkpoint among the last two evaluations: 20261004-tag-T-s3-s4ft100d); the re-run replaces the flagged run in its arm, the flagged run stays recorded (the rule of rounds 1-3). Round 4 arm A3d: the round 3 recipe with the weak build replaced by 20261004-teacher100d (configs/consistency_v2.json: K5 removed, K6/K7/K8 as before). Same recipe, same seeds: only the labels differ. Round 3 arm A3c: exactly train_s1_base_a3.json (A3) with the weak build replaced by 20261004-teacher100c, the consistency-rule version of the same 100 chapters of teacher labels (configs/consistency_v1.json). Same recipe, same seeds: only the labels differ. Stage 1 arm A3: the base backbone first trained on the 749 training chapters' weak S3 labels (the existing, frozen S3 checkpoints runs/20261003-tag-S3-s<seed>-dev31, one per seed) and then fine-tuned on the 100 teacher chapters' Opus labels (setting T of weak build 20261004-teacher100), NEEDLE's two-stage recipe. init_from_run names the checkpoint to start from; '{seed}' is replaced by the run's seed, so seed 1 starts from the S3 seed-1 run, seed 2 from seed 2, and so on (the pairing is recorded in config.json as init_from, with that run's config.json sha256). The run refuses a checkpoint from another backbone id. Everything else (schedule, lr, batch, sufficiency record, checkpoint rule) is train_s1_base: about 1300 planned steps, dev every 2 epochs, patience 6; the sufficiency record shows whether fine-tuning from a trained model needed fewer steps. Intended setting: T only (A3 compares with A2 = T from the fresh backbone: does the weak pre-training still help once teacher labels exist?); W from an S3 checkpoint would re-train on the same label source and is not an arm. Three seeds. Nothing tuned on dev2 or the test.

arms.T: A3d (labels with K7, K6, K8 and no K5; from the S3 checkpoints)

init_from_run_note: '{seed}' is filled with --seed; the named run must be finished (metrics.json, checkpoints/best) and use the same backbone id

backbone.download_note: pytorch_model.bin 411,578,458 bytes plus small tokenizer files (about 412 MB); no safetensors in the repo

planned_steps_note: as train_s1_base: about 32 steps per epoch x 40 epochs = about 1300 steps
